world_mapping.policy: Full original cell mapping, no object-bound fit. Recipient square texture is UV-compressed vertically relative to authoring; existing rectangular Qud world quad restores isotropic physical pixels.

primary_detail_alpha_partition: D=filtered native detail coverage; P=(A-D)/(1-D). Same source luminance in both planes. No double coverage, material chroma, background alpha or destructive body cutoff.
